newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Merrill Lynch underwrites Rostelekom $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch underwrites Rostelekom $100 mln loan.

text.p: Russian telecom Rostelekom has received a $100 million credit underwritten by Merrill Lynch, Rostelekom general director Oleg Belov said on Thursday.
"The money is already in Rostelekom's bank account," he said.
Belov said the money would be used to purchase equipment, but details of the loan were a commercial secret.

Nina Shemetova, Rostelekom executive director, said the credit terms were comparable to those offered to the Russian government for its first Eurobond issue. She said Rostelekom received the credit without government or other guarantees.
She said Rostelekom was still considering issuing Eurobonds, although a murky regulatory situation would make the process more complicated.

"We will continue preparations to issue Eurobonds, but unfortunately (corporate) Eurobonds are still not clearly registered (in legislation) and we are suspending the issuing schedule," said Shemetova.
Rostelekom announced plans earlier to issue the bonds in 1997. In February 1997, Standard & Poor's gave Rostelekom a corporate credit rating of BB minus.
